fixes.fix_explanation: Create a sitemap.xml file that lists all your important pages to help search engines discover and crawl your content more efficiently.
fixes.fix_location: Create a new file named sitemap.xml in the root directory (/sitemap.xml) and upload it to your server.

fixes.fix_code:
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /?s=

Sitemap: https://example-blog.com/sitemap.xml
fixes.fix_explanation: Create a robots.txt file to guide search engines on which pages to crawl and include a reference to your sitemap for better indexing.
fixes.fix_location: Create a new file named robots.txt in the root directory (/robots.txt) and upload it to your server.

fixes.fix_code:

fixes.fix_location: Add this code block inside the <head> section of your HTML, after the existing meta tags and before the closing </head> tag.
